metadata.title: Gemcitabine and Docetaxel Therapy – 21 day
metadata.indication: Locally advanced unresectable or metastatic soft tissue sarcoma.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.

source_boundary_notes: Day 1 requires ANC ≥ 1 and platelets ≥ 100; Day 8 requires ANC ≥ 1 and platelets ≥ 75 ×10⁹/L. A delayed Day 8 dose by Day 15 is not a routine third dose.
Docetaxel Table 3 has a printed bilirubin range < 1–1.5×ULN with mixed AND/OR wording; ALP=6 is unallocated. No numeric docetaxel dose is calculated from these rows.
Gemcitabine hepatic options at bilirubin ≥ 27 µmol/L are 80% of the original 675 mg/m² dose with possible escalation, or full dose with active monitoring; no imported 800 mg/m² dose.
Grade 2 neuropathy first/second occurrences modify BOTH medicines. SCAR and suspected pneumonitis stop gemcitabine; severe docetaxel hypersensitivity stops docetaxel with no rechallenge.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or appropriately authorised specialist named in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component action. Source percentages and dose levels are review instructions, not automatic prescriptions. Confirm dose history, recovery, organ function and the current official source.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00501 Version 4. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.
clinical_governance.organ_function_rule_status: Current source content reconciled in v 0.84.60; source ambiguities and independent clinical/pharmacy approval remain unresolved.

indications.description: Locally advanced unresectable or metastatic soft tissue sarcoma.

treatment.schedule_summary: Gemcitabine 675 mg/m² IV over 90 minutes on Days 1 and 8; docetaxel 75 mg/m² IV over 60 minutes on Day 8. Repeat every 21 days for up to 6 cycles.

eligibility: Locally advanced unresectable or metastatic soft-tissue sarcoma; off-label use requires discussion and documented consent under hospital policy.
ECOG 0–2; adequate marrow, renal and hepatic function.
monitoring: Baseline full blood count, renal/liver and bone profiles.
Full blood count and renal/liver profile before each cycle; confirm separate Day 1/Day 8 count thresholds before dosing.
Assess neuropathy, skin reactions, pulmonary symptoms, fluid retention, infection, renal function and liver tests; review docetaxel premedication before Day 8.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Risk assigned from the most emetogenic active component and treatment phase.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for low emetogenic risk
additional_supportive_care: Dexamethasone 8 mg orally twice daily for 3 days starting Day 7 (the day before docetaxel); minimum 3 pretreatment doses unless contraindicated. Confirm the prescription and report missed doses.
G-CSF may be used according to local policy; this source does not mandate it for every cycle.
Both medicines are low emetogenic risk; use the current prescribed antiemetic plan.
